summary: The SwitchUser functionality manages user login switching within the HSPnet system. It involves switching sessions, determining start screens, handling user roles, and maintaining security cookies.
purpose: To allow users to switch between different user profiles or roles within the HSPnet system while maintaining session integrity and security.

workflows.name: Switch Login
steps: Determine the session procedure based on user role (sysadmin or normal user).
Add session parameters including SessionID and OriginalSessionID.
Execute the session switch stored procedure.
Retrieve the resulting data to update the session and determine the start screen.
Save the security cookie with new session details.

workflows.name: Get Start Screen
steps: Check calling screen and determine the appropriate start screen.
For sysadmin, bypass start screen procedure to maintain user-specific preferences.
Handle start screen redirection based on role and original calling screen.

workflows.name: Go Back To Primary ID
steps: Switch back to the original user ID using the stored procedure.
Redirect to the new screen if determined.

business_rules: Sysadmin does not use the start screen procedure to maintain target user's preferences.
Switching from a normal user allows treating alternate user ID as a normal login.
validations: Check for null or valid session IDs before proceeding with login switching.
calculations: Determine Boolean flags for roles like StudentMaintOnly, GroupInstructorOnly, and SupervisorOnly based on database boolean checks.
conditions: Determine start screen based on presence of roles and original calling page.
system_behavior: Switch user login maintains session integrity and updates security settings.
Ensure redirection to updated ASPX pages from older ASP pages.
exceptions: Handle null or invalid session data gracefully during session read operations.
